messages:
mike: Heads-up — found a 410 on an external schema link in runtime/troubleshooting.md (kv cache mismatch step). Partner removed https://partner.example.com/schema/v2 and our runbook preview flags it.

lena: thanks! which file/line? can you paste the snippet? :mag:

mike: runtime/troubleshooting.md, snippet: ```markdown
See partner schema: https://partner.example.com/schema/v2
```
I pulled an archived copy that matches what we used: https://archive.example.org/partner-schema-v2.json

anya: that runbook gets surfaced by platform-oncall automation so noise for oncall. we should snapshot it in KB or point to an internal static path.

sam: proposal: add /kb/snapshots/partner-schema-v2.json, replace external link, and add footnote that it is a frozen snapshot with timestamp/source. small PR.

lena: +1. include a sed one-liner in the PR to make local testing trivial.

mike: opened PR with snapshot + replacement and a one-line footnote (snapshot date 2026-03-18): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987
sed to apply locally: ```bash
sed -i "s|https://partner.example.com/schema/v2|/kb/snapshots/partner-schema-v2.json|g" runtime/troubleshooting.md
```

anya: assigning to me for review. pinging @lena to sanity-check footnote wording.

lena: LGTM, optional add: review cadence (e.g. rotate every 6 months).

platform-oncall: once merged I will rerun the runbook preview to confirm the broken link no longer appears. :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: CI linkcheck ran for the PR — no new 4xx in docs build.

sam: should we add a changelog line so future oncall know why snapshot exists?

mike: will add a 1-line changelog entry in the PR and squash.

anya: reviewing now, aiming to merge before EOD. drop :eyes: on the PR to co-review.

lena: :eyes:

platform-oncall: merged and preview confirmed — runbook no longer surfaces the broken partner link. closing thread. :tada:
